summary: Perched against a garage Framing crumbling, Pressure of time and profit. Smiles stand witness to Summer's demise. Kisses of autumn cringing as Joy tears I Persephone's eye flipping seasons That can't be undone #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Perched against a garage
Framing crumbling,
Pressure of time and profit.
Smiles stand witness to
Summer's demise.
Kisses of autumn
cringing as
Joy tears I
Persephone's eye
flipping
seasons
That can't be undone
#smallpoems
